title: Results Based Leadership
overview: This course is designed to equip participants with the knowledge, skills, and competencies necessary to become effective results-based leaders. Such leaders are modern, value-driven managers who contribute significantly to their organizations' key performance areas. The course emphasizes the critical role of leaders in inspiring, motivating, engaging, and enhancing the productivity of their teams. It also explores the connection between emotional intelligence, leadership styles, organizational climate, and bottom-line results.
audience: This course is intended for individuals who aim to foster a culture of achievement within their organizations.
methodology: The course employs team activities, group discussions, and debriefs. Participants will also engage in self-assessments to discover their leadership profiles.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify the key attributes and competencies of results-based leaders
Build and lead teams to achieve organizational objectives
Motivate and engage employees using practical leadership techniques
Align departmental and individual performance with organizational goals
Apply the eight leadership communication styles to enhance employee morale and performance
Demonstrate how emotionally intelligent leaders impact organizational climate and drive results
